title: Vector valued de Branges spaces, CNU contractions and functional models
summary: In this paper, we study vector valued de Branges spaces associated with a de Branges operator, defined as a pair of Fredholm operator valued analytic functions on a domain symmetric with respect to the unit circle. Using a suitable direct sum decomposition of a Hilbert space, we construct a class of vector valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces and show that under some assumptions these are vector valued de Branges spaces.
